data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word yarah (to shine or throw), Jarib can be interpreted as 'exalted by God' or 'thrown down by God'. In the Old Testament, Jarib is the name of a Hittite who joins David's army and later becomes a mighty warrior. The name Jarib carries the meaning “Exalted by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jarib usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
